shloka_text: स तस्य तु महानादं श्रुत्वा वैवस्वतः प्रभुः । शत्रुं विजयिनं मेने स्वबलस्य च सङ्क्षयम् ।। 7.22.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tasya tu mahānādaṃ śrutvā vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ | śatruṃ vijayinaṃ mene svabalasya ca saṅkṣayam || 7.22.1 ||
translation: सः he (Yama), तस्य his (Ravana's), तु indeed, महानादम् great roar, श्रुत्वा having heard, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata (Yama), प्रभुः the lord, शत्रुम् the enemy, विजयिनम् victorious, मेने considered, स्वबलस्य of his own army, च and, सङ्क्षयम् destruction.
explanation: Having heard that great roar, Lord Yama considered the enemy victorious and his own army destroyed.
comments: Yama himself takes the field, Death and the staff of Time at his side, and battles Ravana for seven nights -- as he lifts his unfailing rod to slay him, Brahma appears and forbids it, for the rod's fall would falsify the boon protecting Ravana -- Yama withdraws and vanishes, and Ravana proclaims his victory and departs.

shloka_text: स हि योधान्हतान्मत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । अब्रवीत्त्वरितं सूतं रथो ऽयमुपनीयताम् ।। 7.22.2 ।।
transliteration: sa hi yodhānhatānmatvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | abravīttvaritaṃ sūtaṃ ratho 'yamupanīyatām || 7.22.2 ||
translation: सः he (Yama), हि indeed, योधान् the warriors, हतान् killed, मत्वा having considered, क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes reddened by anger, अब्रवीत् said, त्वरितम् quickly, सूतम् to the charioteer, रथः chariot, अयम् this, उपनीयताम् be brought near.
explanation: Indeed, he (Yama), considering his warriors killed and his eyes reddened with anger, quickly told his charioteer, "Bring this chariot near."

shloka_text: तस्य सूतस्तदा दिव्यमुपस्थाप्य महारथम् । स्थितः स च महातेजा ह्यध्यारोहत तं रथम् । प्राशमुद्गरहस्तश्च मृत्युस्तस्याग्रतः स्थितः ।। 7.22.3 ।।
transliteration: tasya sūtastadā divyamupasthāpya mahāratham | sthitaḥ sa ca mahātejā hyadhyārohata taṃ ratham | prāśamudgarahastaśca mṛtyustasyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || 7.22.3 ||
translation: तस्य his (Yama's), सूतः charioteer, तदा then, दिव्यम् divine, उपस्थाप्य having brought near, महारथम् the great chariot, स्थितः stood, सः he (Yama), च and, महातेजाः of great splendor, हि indeed, अध्यारोहत ascended, तम् that, रथम् chariot, प्राशमुद्गरहस्तः with a spear and mace in hand, च and, मृत्युः Death, तस्य his, अग्रतः in front, स्थितः stood.
explanation: Then, his charioteer, having brought near the divine great chariot, stood ready, and Yama, of great splendor, indeed ascended that chariot, while Death, holding a spear and mace, stood before him.

shloka_text: येन सङ्क्षिप्यते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम् । कालदण्डस्तु पार्श्वस्थो मूर्तिमानस्य चाभवत् । यमप्रहरणं दिव्यं तेजसा ज्वलदग्निमत् ।। 7.22.4 ।।
transliteration: yena saṅkṣipyate sarvaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam | kāladaṇḍastu pārśvastho mūrtimānasya cābhavat | yamapraharaṇaṃ divyaṃ tejasā jvaladagnimat || 7.22.4 ||
translation: येन by whom, सङ्क्षिप्यते is contracted, सर्वम् all, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, इदम् this, अव्ययम् imperishable, कालदण्डः the staff of Time, तु indeed, पार्श्वस्थः standing by the side, मूर्तिमान् embodied, अस्य of him, च and, अभवत् became, यमप्रहरणम् Yama's weapon, दिव्यम् divine, तेजसा with splendor, ज्वलत् blazing, अग्निमत् fiery.
explanation: The imperishable three worlds are brought to an end by him, and the staff of Time, Yama's divine, blazing, fiery weapon, appeared personified by his side.

shloka_text: तस्य पार्श्वेषु निच्छिद्राः कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ।। 7.22.5 ।।
transliteration: tasya pārśveṣu nicchidrāḥ kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 7.22.5 ||
translation: तस्य of him, पार्श्वेषु on the sides, निच्छिद्राः inescapable, कालपाशाः the nooses of Time, प्रतिष्ठिताः stood.
explanation: On his sides were placed the inescapable nooses of Time.

shloka_text: पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः स्थितो मूर्तश्च मुद्गरः ।। 7.22.6 ।।
transliteration: pāvakasparśasaṅkāśaḥ sthito mūrtaśca mudgaraḥ || 7.22.6 ||
translation: पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः resembling the touch of fire, स्थितः stood, मूर्तश्च and embodied, मुद्गरः a mace.
explanation: An embodied mace, whose touch was like fire, also stood there.

shloka_text: ततो लोकत्रयं क्षुब्धमकम्पन्त दिवौकसः । कालं दृष्ट्वा तथा क्रुद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम् ।। 7.22.7 ।।
transliteration: tato lokatrayaṃ kṣubdhamakampanta divaukasaḥ | kālaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā kruddhaṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham || 7.22.7 ||
translation: ततः then, लोकत्रयम् the three worlds, क्षुब्धम् agitated, अकम्पन्त trembled, दिवौकसः the gods, कालम् Time, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथा thus, क्रुद्धम् enraged, सर्वलोकभयावहम् terrifying to all worlds.
explanation: Then, having seen Time thus enraged and terrifying to all worlds, the three worlds were agitated and the gods trembled.

shloka_text: ततः प्रचोदयन्सूतस्तानश्वान्रुचिरप्रभान् । प्रययौ भीमसन्नादो यत्र रक्षःपतिः स्थितः ।। 7.22.8 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pracodayansūtastānaśvānruciraprabhān | prayayau bhīmasannādo yatra rakṣaḥpatiḥ sthitaḥ || 7.22.8 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रचोदयन् urging, सूतः the charioteer, तान् those, अश्वान् horses, रुचिरप्रभान् of beautiful splendor, प्रययौ proceeded, भीमसन्नादः with a terrible roar, यत्र where, रक्षःपतिः the lord of Rakshasas, स्थितः was situated.
explanation: Then, the charioteer, urging those brightly shining horses, proceeded with a terrible roar to where the lord of Rakshasas was situated.

shloka_text: मुहूर्तेन यमं ते तु हया हरिहयोपमाः । प्रापयन्मनसस्तुल्या यत्र तत्प्रस्तुतं रणम् ।। 7.22.9 ।।
transliteration: muhūrtena yamaṃ te tu hayā harihayopamāḥ | prāpayanmanasastulyā yatra tatprastutaṃ raṇam || 7.22.9 ||
translation: मुहूर्तेन in a moment, यमम् Yama, ते those, तु indeed, हयाः horses, हरिहयोपमाः resembling the horses of Indra, प्रापयन् made to reach, मनसस्तुल्याः swift as thought, यत्र where, तत् that, प्रस्तुतम् commenced, रणम् battle
explanation: In an instant, those horses, swift as thought and resembling Indra's steeds, brought Yama to the place where the battle had begun.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तथैव विकृतं रथं मृत्युसमन्वितम् । सचिवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। 7.22.10 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tathaiva vikṛtaṃ rathaṃ mṛtyusamanvitam | sacivā rākṣasendrasya sahasā vipradudruvuḥ || 7.22.10 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथैव just so, विकृतम् terrifying, रथम् chariot, मृत्युसमन्वितम् accompanied by death, सचिवाः ministers, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of rakshasas, सहसा suddenly, विप्रदुद्रुवुः fled in all directions
explanation: Upon seeing that terrifying chariot, which seemed to embody death itself, the ministers of Ravana immediately fled in every direction.

shloka_text: लघुसत्त्वतया ते हि नष्टसञ्ज्ञा भयार्दिताः । नेह योद्धुं समर्थाः स्म इत्युक्त्वा प्रययुर्दिशः ।। 7.22.11 ।।
transliteration: laghusattvatayā te hi naṣṭasañjñā bhayārditāḥ | neha yoddhuṃ samarthāḥ sma ityuktvā prayayurdiśaḥ || 7.22.11 ||
translation: लघुसत्त्वतया due to faint-heartedness, ते they, हि indeed, नष्टसञ्ज्ञाः having lost their senses, भयार्दिताः tormented by fear, न not, इह here, योद्धुम् to fight, समर्थाः capable, स्म are, इत्युक्त्वा having said thus, प्रययुर्दिशः fled in all directions
explanation: Overwhelmed by fear and having lost their senses due to their weak courage, they declared, "We are not capable of fighting here," and fled in all directions.

shloka_text: स तु तं तादृशं दृष्ट्वा रथं लोकभयावहम् । नाक्षुभ्यत दशग्रीवो न चापि भयमाविशत् ।। 7.22.12 ।।
transliteration: sa tu taṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathaṃ lokabhayāvaham | nākṣubhyata daśagrīvo na cāpi bhayamāviśat || 7.22.12 ||
translation: सः he, तु but, तम् that, तादृशम् such a, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रथम् chariot, लोकभयावहम् terrifying to the world, न not, अक्षुभ्यत was disturbed, दशग्रीवः Ravana, न not, च and, अपि even, भयम् fear, आविशत् entered
explanation: But Ravana, upon seeing that chariot which struck terror into the world, was neither disturbed nor did fear enter his heart.

shloka_text: स तु रावणमासाद्य व्यसृजच्छक्तितोमरान् । यमो मर्माणि सङ्क्रुद्धो रावणस्योपकृन्तत ।। 7.22.13 ।।
transliteration: sa tu rāvaṇamāsādya vyasṛjacchaktitomarān | yamo marmāṇi saṅkruddho rāvaṇasyopakṛntata || 7.22.13 ||
translation: सः he, तु but, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, व्यसृजत् discharged, शक्तितोमरान् spears and javelins, यमः Yama, मर्माणि vital spots, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, रावणस्य of Ravana, उपकृन्तत pierced
explanation: Yama, greatly enraged, approached Ravana and hurled spears and javelins, piercing Ravana's vital spots.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु ततः स्वस्थः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह । तस्मिन्वैवस्वतरथे तोयवर्षमिवाम्बुदः ।। 7.22.14 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu tataḥ svasthaḥ śaravarṣaṃ mumoca ha | tasminvaivasvatarathe toyavarṣamivāmbudaḥ || 7.22.14 ||
translation: रावणस्तु Ravana, but, ततः then, स्वस्थः composed, शरवर्षं a rain of arrows, मुमोच released, ह indeed, तस्मिन् on that, वैवस्वतरथे chariot of Yama, तोयवर्षम् a rain of water, इव like, अम्बुदः a cloud
explanation: Ravana, having regained his composure, then released a shower of arrows upon Yama's chariot, much like a cloud pouring down rain.

shloka_text: ततो महाशक्तिशरैः पात्यमानैर्महोरसि (पात्यमानो) । नाशक्नोत्प्रतिकर्तुं स राक्षसः शल्यपीडितः ।। 7.22.15 ।।
transliteration: tato mahāśaktiśaraiḥ pātyamānairmahorasi (pātyamāno) | nāśaknotpratikartuṃ sa rākṣasaḥ śalyapīḍitaḥ || 7.22.15 ||
translation: ततः then, महाशक्तिशरैः by arrows of great power, पात्यमानैः being struck down, महोरसि on his great chest, न not, अशक्नोत् was able, प्रतिकर्तुं to retaliate, स that, राक्षसः demon, शल्यपीडितः afflicted by arrows
explanation: Then, as powerful arrows struck his broad chest, that demon, afflicted by the shafts, was unable to retaliate.

shloka_text: एवं नानाप्रहरणैर्यमेनामित्रकर्षिणा । सप्तरात्रं कृतः सङ्ख्ये विसञ्ज्ञो विमुखो रिपुः ।। 7.22.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ nānāpraharaṇairyamenāmitrakarṣiṇā | saptarātraṃ kṛtaḥ saṅkhye visañjño vimukho ripuḥ || 7.22.16 ||
translation: एवं thus, नानाप्रहरणैः by various weapons, यमेन by Yama, अमित्रकर्षिणा the tormentor of enemies, सप्तरात्रं for seven nights, कृतः made, सङ्ख्ये in battle, विसञ्ज्ञः unconscious, विमुखः turned away, रिपुः the enemy
explanation: Thus, for seven nights in battle, the enemy Ravana was rendered senseless and turned away by Yama, the tormentor of foes, using various weapons.

shloka_text: तदासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं यमराक्षसयोर्द्वयोः । जयमाकाङ्क्षतोर्वीर समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः ।। 7.22.17 ।।
transliteration: tadāsīttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ yamarākṣasayordvayoḥ | jayamākāṅkṣatorvīra samareṣvanivartinoḥ || 7.22.17 ||
translation: तदा then, आसीत् was, तुमुलं a tumultuous, युद्धं battle, यमराक्षसयोः between Yama and the demon, द्वयोः of the two, जयम् victory, आकाङ्क्षतोः desiring, वीर O hero, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनोः unyielding
explanation: Then, a fierce battle ensued between Yama and the demon, both unyielding warriors desiring victory in their fight.

shloka_text: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य समेतास्तद्रणाजिरम् ।। 7.22.18 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | prajāpatiṃ puraskṛtya sametāstadraṇājiram || 7.22.18 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः the gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, प्रजापतिं Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, समेताः assembled, तत् that, रणाजिरम् battlefield
explanation: Then, the gods, along with Gandharvas, Siddhas, and great sages, assembled at that battlefield, led by Prajapati Brahma.

shloka_text: संवर्त इव लोकानां क्रुध्यतोरभवत्तदा । राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य प्रेतानामीश्वरस्य च ।। 7.22.19 ।।
transliteration: saṃvarta iva lokānāṃ krudhyatorabhavattadā | rākṣasānāṃ ca mukhyasya pretānāmīśvarasya ca || 7.22.19 ||
translation: संवर्त इव like the cosmic dissolution, लोकानां of the worlds, क्रुध्यतोः of the two who were enraged, अभवत् it became, तदा then, राक्षसानां च and of the Rākṣasas, मुख्यस्य of the chief, प्रेतानाम् of the departed spirits, ईश्वरस्य च and of the lord.
explanation: Then, the battle between the chief of the Rākṣasas and the lord of the departed spirits became like the cosmic dissolution of the worlds.

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽपि विस्फार्य चापमिन्द्राशनिप्रभम् । निरन्तरमिवाकाशं कुर्वन्बाणांस्ततो ऽसृजत् ।। 7.22.20 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendro 'pi visphārya cāpamindrāśaniprabham | nirantaramivākāśaṃ kurvanbāṇāṃstato 'sṛjat || 7.22.20 ||
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽपि the lord of Rākṣasas also, विस्फार्य having stretched, चापम् his bow, इन्द्राशनिप्रभम् shining like Indra's thunderbolt, निरन्तरम् इव as if without gaps, आकाशं the sky, कुर्वन् making, बाणान् arrows, ततः then, असृजत् he released.
explanation: The lord of Rākṣasas, drawing his bow which shone like Indra's thunderbolt, then released arrows, making the sky appear as if it had no gaps.

shloka_text: मृत्युं चतुर्भिर्विशिखैः सूतं सप्तभिरार्दयत् । यमं शतसहस्रेण शीघ्रं मर्मस्वताडयत् ।। 7.22.21 ।।
transliteration: mṛtyuṃ caturbhirviśikhaiḥ sūtaṃ saptabhirārdayat | yamaṃ śatasahasreṇa śīghraṃ marmasvatāḍayat || 7.22.21 ||
translation: मृत्युं Death, चतुर्भिः with four, विशिखैः sharp arrows, सूतं the charioteer, सप्तभिः with seven, आर्दयत् he afflicted, यमं Yama, शतसहस्रेण with a hundred thousand, शीघ्रं quickly, मर्मसु in the vital spots, अताडयत् he struck.
explanation: Rāvaṇa wounded Death with four sharp arrows, afflicted the charioteer with seven, and quickly struck Yama in his vital spots with a hundred thousand arrows.

shloka_text: ततः क्रुद्धस्य वदनाद्यमस्य समजायत । ज्वालामाली सनिःश्वासः सधूमः कोपपावकः ।। 7.22.22 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddhasya vadanādyamasya samajāyata | jvālāmālī saniḥśvāsaḥ sadhūmaḥ kopapāvakaḥ || 7.22.22 ||
translation: ततः then, क्रुद्धस्य of the enraged one, वदनात् from the face, यमस्य of Yama, समजायत arose, ज्वालामाली garlanded with flames, सनिःश्वासः with breath, सधूमः with smoke, कोपपावकः the fire of anger.
explanation: Then, from the enraged Yama's face, a fire of anger arose, garlanded with flames, accompanied by his breath and smoke.

shloka_text: तदाश्चर्यमथो दृष्ट्वा देवदानवसन्निधौ । प्रहर्षितौ सुसंरब्धौ मृत्युकालौ बभूवतुः ।। 7.22.23 ।।
transliteration: tadāścaryamatho dṛṣṭvā devadānavasannidhau | praharṣitau susaṃrabdhau mṛtyukālau babhūvatuḥ || 7.22.23 ||
translation: तत् that, आश्चर्यम् wonder, अथ then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवदानवसन्निधौ in the presence of gods and Dānavas, प्रहर्षितौ greatly delighted, सुसंरब्धौ greatly agitated, मृत्युकालौ Death and Kāla, बभूवतुः they became.
explanation: Then, having witnessed that marvel in the presence of gods and Dānavas, Death and Kāla became greatly delighted and exceedingly furious.

shloka_text: ततो मृत्युः क्रुद्धतरो वैवस्वतमभाषत । मुञ्च मां समरे यावद्धन्मीमं पापराक्षसम् । नैषा रक्षो भवेदद्य मर्यादा हि निसर्गतः ।। 7.22.24 ।।
transliteration: tato mṛtyuḥ kruddhataro vaivasvatamabhāṣata | muñca māṃ samare yāvaddhanmīmaṃ pāparākṣasam | naiṣā rakṣo bhavedadya maryādā hi nisargataḥ || 7.22.24 ||
translation: ततः then, मृत्युः Death, क्रुद्धतरः more enraged, वैवस्वतम् to Vaivasvata (Yama), अभाषत spoke, मुञ्च release, माम् me, समरे in battle, यावत् until, हन्मि I kill, इमम् this, पापरक्षसम् sinful demon, न not, एषा this, रक्षः demon, भवेत् should be, अद्य today, मर्यादा a limit/boundary, हि indeed, निसर्गतः by nature/inherently
explanation: Then, Death, even more enraged, spoke to Yama, saying, "Release me in battle so that I may kill this sinful demon, for by nature, this demon should not exist today as a boundary."

shloka_text: हिरण्यकशिपुः श्रीमान्नमुचिः शम्बरस्तथा । विसन्धिर्धूमकेतुश्च बलिर्वैरोचनो ऽपि च ।। 7.22.25 ।।
transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipuḥ śrīmānnamuciḥ śambarastathā | visandhirdhūmaketuśca balirvairocano 'pi ca || 7.22.25 ||
translation: हिरण्यकशिपुः Hiranyakashipu, श्रीमान् glorious, नमुचिः Namuchi, शम्बरः Shambara, तथा and, विसन्धिः Visandhi, धूमकेतुः Dhumaketu, च and, बलिः Bali, वैरोचनः Vairochana, अपि also, च and
explanation: The glorious Hiranyakashipu, Namuchi, Shambara, Visandhi, Dhumaketu, and Bali Vairochana were among them.

shloka_text: दम्भुर्दैत्यमहाराजो वृत्रो बाणस्तथैव च । राजर्षयः शास्त्रविदो गन्धर्वाः समहोरगाः ।। 7.22.26 ।।
transliteration: dambhurdaityamahārājo vṛtro bāṇastathaiva ca | rājarṣayaḥ śāstravido gandharvāḥ samahoragāḥ || 7.22.26 ||
translation: दम्भुः Dambhu, दैत्यमहाराजः the great king of Daityas, वृत्रः Vritra, बाणः Bana, तथा and, एव indeed, च and, राजर्षयः royal sages, शास्त्रविदः knowers of scriptures, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, समहोरगाः along with great serpents
explanation: Dambhu, the great king of Daityas, Vritra, and Bana, along with royal sages who knew the scriptures, Gandharvas, and great serpents, were also present.

shloka_text: ऋषयः पन्नगा दैत्या यक्षाश्चाप्यप्सरोगणाः । युगान्तपरिवर्ते च पृथिवी समहार्णवा ।। 7.22.27 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ pannagā daityā yakṣāścāpyapsarogaṇāḥ | yugāntaparivarte ca pṛthivī samahārṇavā || 7.22.27 ||
translation: ऋषयः sages, पन्नगाः serpents, दैत्याः Daityas, यक्षाः Yakshas, च and, अपि also, अप्सरोगणाः groups of Apsaras, युगान्तपरिवर्ते at the change of a Yuga (end of an age), च and, पृथिवी the earth, समहार्णवा along with great oceans
explanation: Sages, serpents, Daityas, Yakshas, and groups of Apsaras, along with the earth and its great oceans at the end of an age, were all present.

shloka_text: क्षयं नीता महाराज सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमा । एते चान्ये च बहवो बलवन्तो दुरासदाः ।। 7.22.28 ।।
transliteration: kṣayaṃ nītā mahārāja saparvatasariddrumā | ete cānye ca bahavo balavanto durāsadāḥ || 7.22.28 ||
translation: क्षयम् to destruction, नीताः led/brought, महाराज O great king, सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमाः along with mountains, rivers, and trees, एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवः many, बलवन्तः powerful, दुरासदाः difficult to approach/overcome
explanation: O great king, these and many other powerful and formidable beings, along with mountains, rivers, and trees, were all brought to destruction.

shloka_text: विनिपन्ना मया दृष्टाः किमुतायं निशाचरः ।। 7.22.29 ।।
transliteration: vinipannā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kimutāyaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.22.29 ||
translation: विनिपन्ना fallen, मया by me, दृष्टाः seen, किमुत how much more, अयं this, निशाचरः demon.
explanation: I have seen many fallen, so what to say of this demon?

shloka_text: मुञ्चं मां साधु धर्मज्ञ यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम् । नहि कश्चिन्मया दृष्टो बलवानपि जीवति ।। 7.22.30 ।।
transliteration: muñcaṃ māṃ sādhu dharmajña yāvadenaṃ nihanmyaham | nahi kaścinmayā dṛṣṭo balavānapi jīvati || 7.22.30 ||
translation: मुञ्चं release, मां me, साधु properly, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, यावत् until, एनं this one, निहन्मि I kill, अहम् I, न हि certainly not, कश्चित् anyone, मया by me, दृष्टो seen, बलवानपि even if powerful, जीवति lives.
explanation: O knower of dharma, release me so I may kill this one, for no one seen by me, however powerful, has ever lived.

shloka_text: बलं मम न खल्वेतन्मर्यादैषा निसर्गतः । स दृष्टो न मया कालं मुहुर्तमापि जीवति ।। 7.22.31 ।।
transliteration: balaṃ mama na khalvetanmaryādaiṣā nisargataḥ | sa dṛṣṭo na mayā kālaṃ muhurtamāpi jīvati || 7.22.31 ||
translation: बलं strength, मम my, न खलु certainly not, एतत् this, मर्यादा rule, एषा this, निसर्गतः by nature, सः he, दृष्टो seen, न not, मया by me, कालं for time, मुहुर्तमापि even for a moment, जीवति lives.
explanation: This is not merely my strength, but a natural rule that anyone seen by me does not live even for a moment.

shloka_text: तस्यैवं वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान् । अब्रवीत्तत्र तं मुत्युं त्वं तिष्ठैनं निहन्म्यहम् ।। 7.22.32 ।।
transliteration: tasyaivaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājaḥ pratāpavān | abravīttatra taṃ mutyuṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhainaṃ nihanmyaham || 7.22.32 ||
translation: तस्य his, एवं thus, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, धर्मराजः Dharmaraja, प्रतापवान् powerful, अब्रवीत् said, तत्र there, तं to him, मृत्युं to Death, त्वं you, तिष्ठ wait, एनं this one, निहन्मि I kill, अहम् I.
explanation: Having heard his words, the powerful Dharmaraja then said to Death, "You wait, I will kill this one."

shloka_text: ततः संरक्तनयनः क्रुद्धो वैवस्वतः प्रभुः । कालदण्डममोघं तु तोलयामास पाणिना ।। 7.22.33 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṃraktanayanaḥ kruddho vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ | kāladaṇḍamamoghaṃ tu tolayāmāsa pāṇinā || 7.22.33 ||
translation: ततः then, संरक्तनयनः with blood-red eyes, क्रुद्धो enraged, वैवस्वतः Yama, प्रभुः lord, कालदण्डम् the rod of time/death, अमोघं unfailing, तु indeed, तोलयामास lifted, पाणिना with his hand.
explanation: Then, the enraged Lord Yama, with blood-red eyes, indeed lifted his unfailing rod of death with his hand.

shloka_text: यस्य पार्श्वेषु निखिला कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । पावकाशनिसङ्काशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः ।। 7.22.34 ।।
transliteration: yasya pārśveṣu nikhilā kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | pāvakāśanisaṅkāśo mudgaro mūrtimānsthitaḥ || 7.22.34 ||
translation: यस्य whose, पार्श्वेषु on the sides, निखिला all, कालपाशाः nooses of Death, प्रतिष्ठिताः are established, पावकाशनिसङ्काशो like fire and lightning, मुद्गरो a mace, मूर्तिमान् embodied, स्थितः stands.
explanation: On whose sides all the nooses of Death are established, and an embodied mace, resembling fire and lightning, stands.

shloka_text: दर्शनादेव यः प्राणान्प्राणिनामपकर्षति । किं पुनः स्पृश्यमानस्य पात्यमानस्य वा पुनः ।। 7.22.35 ।।
transliteration: darśanādeva yaḥ prāṇānprāṇināmapakarṣati | kiṃ punaḥ spṛśyamānasya pātyamānasya vā punaḥ || 7.22.35 ||
translation: दर्शनादेव merely by seeing, यः who, प्राणान् lives, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपकर्षति draws away, किं what, पुनः moreover, स्पृश्यमानस्य of one being touched, पात्यमानस्य of one being struck down, वा or, पुनः again.
explanation: What more can be said of one who is touched or struck down, when merely by sight it draws away the lives of living beings?

shloka_text: स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु निर्दहन्निव राक्षसम् । तेन स्पृष्टो बलवता महाप्रहरणो ऽस्फुरत् ।। 7.22.36 ।।
transliteration: sa jvālāparivārastu nirdahanniva rākṣasam | tena spṛṣṭo balavatā mahāpraharaṇo 'sphurat || 7.22.36 ||
translation: स that, ज्वालापरिवारस्तु surrounded by flames, निर्दहन्निव as if burning, राक्षसम् the demon, तेन by him, स्पृष्टो touched, बलवता by the powerful one, महाप्रहरणो the great weapon, अस्फुरत् trembled.
explanation: That great weapon, surrounded by flames as if burning the demon, trembled when touched by the powerful Yama.

shloka_text: ततो विदुद्रुवुः सर्वे तस्मात्रस्ता रणाजिरे । सुराश्च क्षुभिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा दण्डोद्यतं यमम् ।। 7.22.37 ।।
transliteration: tato vidudruvuḥ sarve tasmātrastā raṇājire | surāśca kṣubhitāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā daṇḍodyataṃ yamam || 7.22.37 ||
translation: ततो then, विदुद्रुवुः fled, सर्वे all, तस्मात् from that, त्रस्ता terrified, रणाजिरे on the battlefield, सुराश्च and the gods, क्षुभिताः agitated, सर्वे all, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दण्डोद्यतं with the mace raised, यमम् Yama.
explanation: Then all those on the battlefield, terrified by that, fled, and all the gods were agitated upon seeing Yama with his mace raised.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रहर्तुकामे तु यमे दण्डेन रावणम् । यमं पितामहः साक्षाद्दर्शयित्वेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.22.38 ।।
transliteration: tasminprahartukāme tu yame daṇḍena rāvaṇam | yamaṃ pitāmahaḥ sākṣāddarśayitvedamabravīt || 7.22.38 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when that, प्रहर्तुकामे desirous of striking, तु indeed, यमे Yama, दण्डेन with the mace, रावणम् Ravana, यमं to Yama, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma), साक्षात् directly, दर्शयित्वा having appeared, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: When Yama was indeed desirous of striking Ravana with his mace, the grandfather Brahma directly appeared before Yama and spoke these words.

shloka_text: वैवस्वत महाबाहो न खल्वमितविक्रम । न हन्तव्यस्त्वया तेन दण्डेनैव निशाचरः ।। 7.22.39 ।।
transliteration: vaivasvata mahābāho na khalvamitavikrama | na hantavyastvayā tena daṇḍenaiva niśācaraḥ || 7.22.39 ||
translation: वैवस्वत O son of Vivasvat, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, खलु indeed, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable prowess, न not, हन्तव्यः to be killed, त्वया by you, तेन by that, दण्डेनैव by the staff alone, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (demon).
explanation: O mighty-armed Yama, son of Vivasvat, you of immeasurable prowess, indeed that demon should not be killed by your staff alone.

shloka_text: वरः खलु मयैतस्मै दत्तस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव । स त्वया नानृतः कार्यो यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः ।। 7.22.40 ।।
transliteration: varaḥ khalu mayaitasmai dattastridaśapuṅgava | sa tvayā nānṛtaḥ kāryo yanmayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 7.22.40 ||
translation: वरः a boon, खलु indeed, मया by me, एतस्मै to him, दत्तः given, त्रिदशपुङ्गव O chief among gods, सः that, त्वया by you, न not, अनृतः false, कार्यः to be made, यत् which, मया by me, व्याहृतं spoken, वचः word.
explanation: O chief among gods, indeed a boon has been given by me to him, and that word spoken by me should not be made false by you.

shloka_text: यो हि मामनृतं कुर्याद्देवो वा मानुषो ऽपि वा । त्रैलोक्यमनृतं तेन कृतं स्यान्नात्र संशयः ।। 7.22.41 ।।
transliteration: yo hi māmanṛtaṃ kuryāddevo vā mānuṣo 'pi vā | trailokyamanṛtaṃ tena kṛtaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.22.41 ||
translation: यः whoever, हि indeed, माम् me, अनृतं false, कुर्यात् would make, देवः a god, वा or, मानुषः a human, अपि even, वा or, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, अनृतं false, तेन by him, कृतं made, स्यात् would be, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Whoever, be it a god or even a human, would make my word false, by him the three worlds would indeed be made false, there is no doubt about this.

shloka_text: क्रुद्धेन विप्रमुक्तो ऽयं निर्विशेषं प्रियाप्रिये । प्रजाः संहरते रौद्रो लोकत्रयभयावहः ।। 7.22.42 ।।
transliteration: kruddhena vipramukto 'yaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ priyāpriye | prajāḥ saṃharate raudro lokatrayabhayāvahaḥ || 7.22.42 ||
translation: क्रुद्धेन by the angry one, विप्रमुक्तः released, अयम् this, निर्विशेषं without distinction, प्रियाप्रिये between dear and not dear, प्रजाः creatures, संहरते destroys, रौद्रः terrible, लोकत्रयभयावहः causing fear to the three worlds.
explanation: This terrible staff, when released by an angry one, destroys creatures without distinction between dear and not dear, causing fear to all three worlds.

shloka_text: अमोघो ह्येष सर्वेषां प्राणिनाममितप्रभः । कालदण्डो मया सृष्टः पूर्वं मृत्युपुरस्कृतः ।। 7.22.43 ।।
transliteration: amogho hyeṣa sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmamitaprabhaḥ | kāladaṇḍo mayā sṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ mṛtyupuraskṛtaḥ || 7.22.43 ||
translation: अमोघः unfailing, हि indeed, एषः this, सर्वेषां of all, प्राणिनाम् living beings, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable power, कालदण्डः the staff of time/death, मया by me, सृष्टः created, पूर्वं formerly, मृत्युपुरस्कृतः preceded by Death.
explanation: Indeed, this unfailing staff of Time, of immeasurable power for all living beings, was created by me long ago, with Death as its foremost aspect.

shloka_text: तन्न खल्वेष ते सौम्य पात्यो रावणमूर्धनि । नह्यस्मिन्पतिते कश्चिन्मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ।। 7.22.44 ।।
transliteration: tanna khalveṣa te saumya pātyo rāvaṇamūrdhani | nahyasminpatite kaścinmuhūrtamapi jīvati || 7.22.44 ||
translation: तत् that, न not, खलु indeed, एष this, ते by you, सौम्य O gentle one, पात्यो to be cast, रावणमूर्धनि on Ravana's head । नहि indeed not, अस्मिन् on this, पतिते having fallen, कश्चित् anyone, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवति lives ।।
explanation: O gentle one (Yama), this rod of yours should certainly not be cast upon Ravana's head, for indeed, no one survives even for a moment once this rod has fallen.

shloka_text: यदि ह्यन्मिन्निपतिते न म्रियेतैष राक्षसः । म्रियते वा दशग्रीवस्तदाप्युभयतो ऽनृतम् ।। 7.22.45 ।।
transliteration: yadi hyanminnipatite na mriyetaiṣa rākṣasaḥ | mriyate vā daśagrīvastadāpyubhayato 'nṛtam || 7.22.45 ||
translation: यदि if, हि indeed, अस्मिन् on this, निपतिते having fallen, न not, म्रियेत dies, एष this, राक्षसः demon । म्रियते dies, वा or, दशग्रीवः Ravana, तदापि then even, उभयतो from both sides, अनृतम् untruth ।।
explanation: If this demon (Ravana) does not die even after this rod has fallen, or if Ravana dies, then in either case, it would be a falsehood (regarding the boon of immortality).

shloka_text: तन्निवर्तय लङ्केशं द्दण्डमेतं समुद्यतम् । सत्यं च मां कुरुष्वाद्य लोकांस्त्वं यद्यवेक्षसे ।। 7.22.46 ।।
transliteration: tannivartaya laṅkeśaṃ ddaṇḍametaṃ samudyatam | satyaṃ ca māṃ kuruṣvādya lokāṃstvaṃ yadyavekṣase || 7.22.46 ||
translation: तत् therefore, निवर्तय withdraw, लङ्केशं from Ravana, दण्डम् rod, एतम् this, समुद्यतम् uplifted । सत्यं true, च and, मां me, कुरुष्व make, अद्य now, लोकान् worlds, त्वं you, यदि if, अवेक्षसे regard ।।
explanation: Therefore, withdraw this uplifted rod from Ravana and make my words true now, if you indeed care for the worlds.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच यमस्तदा । एष व्यावर्तितो दण्डः प्रभविष्णुर्हि नो भवान् ।। 7.22.47 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā pratyuvāca yamastadā | eṣa vyāvartito daṇḍaḥ prabhaviṣṇurhi no bhavān || 7.22.47 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, प्रत्युवाच replied, यमः Yama, तदा then । एष this, व्यावर्तितः withdrawn, दण्डः rod, प्रभविष्णुः powerful lord, हि indeed, नः our, भवान् you ।।
explanation: Thus spoken to, the righteous Yama then replied, "This rod has been withdrawn, for indeed, you are our powerful lord."

shloka_text: किं न्विदानीं मया शक्यं कर्तुं रणगतेन हि । न मया यद्ययं शक्यो हन्तुं वरपुरस्कृतः ।। 7.22.48 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ nvidānīṃ mayā śakyaṃ kartuṃ raṇagatena hi | na mayā yadyayaṃ śakyo hantuṃ varapuraskṛtaḥ || 7.22.48 ||
translation: किं नु what indeed, इदानीं now, मया by me, शक्यं possible, कर्तुं to do, रणगतेन having gone to battle, हि indeed । न not, मया by me, यदि if, अयम् this, शक्यः possible, हन्तुं to kill, वरपुरस्कृतः protected by a boon ।।
explanation: What indeed can I do now, having come to battle, if this one (Ravana) cannot be killed by me because he is protected by a boon?

shloka_text: एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः । इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।। 7.22.49 ।।
transliteration: eṣa tasmātpraṇaśyāmi darśanādasya rakṣasaḥ | ityuktvā sarathaḥ sāśvastatraivāntaradhīyata || 7.22.49 ||
translation: एष this, तस्मात् therefore, प्रणश्यामि I disappear, दर्शनात् from the sight, अस्य of this, रक्षसः demon, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सरथः with his chariot, साश्वः with his horses, तत्रैव right there, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.
explanation: Having said, "Therefore, I disappear from the sight of this demon," he vanished right there with his chariot and horses.

shloka_text: दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः । आरुह्य पुष्पकं भूयो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात् ।। 7.22.50 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvastu taṃ jitvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ | āruhya puṣpakaṃ bhūyo niṣkrānto yamasādanāt || 7.22.50 ||
translation: दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तु and, तम् him, जित्वा having conquered, नाम name, विश्राव्य having proclaimed, च and, आत्मनः his own, आरुह्य having ascended, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, भूयः again, निष्क्रान्तः departed, यमसादनात् from Yama's abode.
explanation: Dashagriva, having conquered him and proclaimed his own name, ascended the Pushpaka chariot again and departed from Yama's abode.

shloka_text: स तु वैवस्वतो देवैः सह ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः । जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो नारदश्च महामुनिः ।। 7.22.51 ।।
transliteration: sa tu vaivasvato devaiḥ saha brahmapurogamaiḥ | jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ || 7.22.51 ||
translation: सः he, तु and, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata (Yama), देवैः with the gods, सह together, ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः with Brahma as their leader, जगाम went, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, हृष्टः delighted, नारदः Narada, च and, महामुनिः the great sage.
explanation: And Vaivasvata (Yama), delighted, went to heaven along with the gods led by Brahma, as did the great sage Narada. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वाविंशः सर्गः ।। 22 ।। Thus ends the twenty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
